ready2_open_rewrite.final_cot: First describe the image: The figure marks the locations of Dunhuang, Golmud, and the Dunhuang-to-Golmud Railway T. The route is located in the Gansu-Qinghai area of northwestern inland China, close to the vicinity of the provincial boundary, and the surrounding area belongs to a desert and basin distribution area. Then reason: The question asks to judge the overall surface characteristics of the section through which Railway T passes. The Dunhuang-Golmud line is located in the arid and semi-arid northwestern inland region, with strong wind-sand activity and widespread deserts and sandy deserts, so the typical surface manifestation is wide and continuous distribution of sand dunes.

raw_record.question_text:
The following figure shows the Dunhuang-to-Golmud Railway (T) under construction in China. Answer according to the figure: Overall, what are the surface characteristics of the section through which Railway T passes?

<image1>

method.method_draft: 先从图像中读出铁路T连接敦煌与格尔木，位置在我国西北内陆、甘肃—青海一带，并且线路大体经过省界附近的荒漠区。再从题干读出问题要求判断“T铁路所经地段”的总体地表特征。利用地理知识：敦煌至格尔木位于干旱、半干旱的西北内陆，靠近柴达木盆地和荒漠分布区，风沙活动强，典型地表为沙漠、沙丘广布。因此概括为“沙丘连片”。
